alt: 同一艘船上的人穿著救生衣，一起划槳、互相配合，朝平靜的岸邊前進。
scene_prompt: 同舟共濟 means working together through a shared difficulty. A modern family of FOUR in ONE sturdy small rowing boat on a lake, everyone in correctly worn life jackets. Two adults and two older children cooperate to row in the SAME direction in a brief patch of wind and modest choppy waves, concentrating and encouraging each other, moving toward the visible sheltered peaceful shore at right. Paddles on both sides, synchronized movement and unified purpose unmistakable. Small realistic challenge, nobody falling, no drowning, no extreme storm. Gentle hopeful atmosphere with pale sky-blue water and grass-green shoreline. The entire one boat is visible; no other boats.
